status: exact gate classification with finite witnesses; no baryogenesis or cosmological-constant solution

sakharov.scope: conventional local Lorentz-invariant CPT-preserving QFT beginning from zero baryon asymmetry
necessaryConditions: baryon-number violation, directly or through lepton-number violation followed by electroweak sphaleron conversion

programmeIngredients.baryonOrLeptonViolation: the E6/Spin(10) branch contains right-handed-neutrino and Majorana channels, while electroweak sphalerons violate B+L and conserve B-L
programmeIngredients.cpViolation: the corpus contains nonzero flavor-CP capacity, but a low-energy CKM or PMNS invariant does not by itself fix the heavy-decay invariant
programmeIngredients.nonequilibrium: no finite-temperature transition, decay-rate-versus-Hubble, or kinetic transport solution has yet been derived

toyLeptogenesisInvariant.meaning: a nonzero heavy-sector CP-odd invariant is possible; its magnitude, washout, spectrum and sign are not derived

timeReversal.microscopicT: an antiunitary transformation comparing transition amplitudes with initial and final states exchanged and momenta/spins reversed
timeReversal.cptConditionalRelation: if the completed theory satisfies the hypotheses of CPT, CP violation requires compensating T violation
notEquivalentTo: an oriented selector label without an operator intertwiner

yangMillsQft.compactInternalRole: SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) Yang-Mills fields and chiral matter arise only after a declared E6/Spin(10) breaking and threshold map
yangMillsQft.spin23Role: Spin(2,3) is most naturally a spacetime Cartan/MacDowell-Mansouri parent, not another compact internal Yang-Mills factor
yangMillsQft.cartanDecomposition: A=(1/2) omega^{ab} J_ab + ell^{-1} e^a J_a4
quantumAdmission: local action and complete field representations
gauge fixing and nilpotent BRST or equivalent constraint cohomology
unitary physical poles and positive residues
finite-temperature and curved-background definition where cosmology is claimed

reducedPotentialWitness.unchangedData: stationary point, Hessian, particle masses and nongravitational transition amplitudes

vacuumEnergy.consequence: the existing stable-vacuum theorem does not predict the gravitating zero of energy; the Cartan radius and matter vacuum contributions require a radiatively stable matching law

decision: the programme has plausible ingredients for leptogenesis and gauge gravity, but physical closure requires a BRST-complete QFT, a heavy-sector CP/T invariant, a nonequilibrium transport solution and a radiatively stable vacuum-energy matching condition
